key.name: show-case-card
key.description: Shows the battery levels, or a Connect button, at the bottom of the screen when the case of paired AirPods opens nearby. Never over a fullscreen window or while the screen is shared.

key.name: engine-install-offered
key.description: Whether the one notification offering to install the AirPods engine was shown. It is shown once, the first time the engine is found missing; AirPods Settings keeps offering the install afterwards.
